task.title: What's New in X-Author for Contracts v202409.1.0
task.shortdesc: This section lists changes in the documentation to support each release.

context.p: This section lists changes in the documentation to support each release.

entry.p: Removed prerequisite and added the Asking Questions for Any Document section.
Removed Behavior and Limitation section with workaround to a known issue where users had to add a space before and after inserted clauses.
Removed the restriction note about needing to check-in a template before inserting a clause from the clause library.

Updated Step 5 of To View and Change Fields and updated the note after Step 9.Changed mentions of "Marked for Removal" to "Marked for Delete".
Updated Step 3 of To Open or To Open and Update a Contract Document and updated the note after Step 4.
Updated the Category and Subcategory descriptions in the table.

Updated Step 4 in the Marking Clauses for Removal section.

Updated the overview, Step 3, and Step 5.

p.xref: Using the Clause Library for a Template

entry.p: Added the following note:Older templates with clauses inserted from the Clause Library will still allow edits. Restriction of edit actions on inserted clauses applies only to clauses inserted after the October'23 release.
Updated note at the bottom of the topic.
Added Step 7 which details the Retain Document Name option.
Added Clause Behavior entry to the options table.

p.xref: Using the Clause Library for a Template

entry.p: Updated with information on inserting read-only clauses.Added a note stating that after you insert a clause into a template, you cannot edit text, insert or mark a field, or mark segments within the clause.

p.xref: Using the Clause Library for a Contract

entry.p: Updated with information on inserting read-only clauses.

Added the following:Category and subcategory fields are retrieved from the Agreement clause objectIf the Category and Subcategory do not match the Agreement Clause object when promoting a clause from the Template Object, then users must manually select the Category and Subcategory while marking a clause.Removed outdated content.

entry.p: Updated topic with Read-Only Field option information
Added the following:Category and subcategory fields are retrieved from the Agreement clause object
